chunks: Have they not travelled on the earth and seen how the others before them had met their end? They were far more powerful than them, furrowed the earth and colonised it far more than they; and their apostles came to them with visible signs. It was surely not for God to wrong them, they wronged themselves.
ai.seo_question: What is the lesson from the fate of previous nations in Surah Ar-Rum?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse serves as a foundational lesson in 'tarih al-tadabbur' (historical reflection), urging believers to analyze the causal link between societal corruption and divine punishment. It highlights that the destruction of previous nations was not due to God's injustice, but rather their own self-inflicted wrongs through rejecting the clear proofs brought by their prophets.
